resources.string: Use a staff account for this café. This tablet stays signed in, so you only do this once.
This tablet will print the tickets for one branch.
Make sure the printer is switched on and on the same WiFi. Looking for it now…

Nothing found. If the printer is switched on and plugged into the same network, it is probably on a different range of addresses than this tablet — search wider below, or get its address from the printer itself: switch it off, hold the FEED button, switch it on. It prints its own settings slip with the address on it. Type that in with “Enter the address myself”.

Still nothing. Get the address off the printer itself — switch it off, hold FEED, switch it on, and it prints a slip with its address — then use “Enter the address myself”. If that will not connect either, the printer is on a network this tablet cannot reach, and the two have to be joined to the same one.
Found %1$d printers. Pick the one at your counter.
Answered, but it is out of paper
Pick your printer. Only printers already paired with this tablet are listed.
Paired · reports itself as a printer
Nothing is paired with this tablet yet. Pair the printer in Android\'s Bluetooth settings first, then come back.
Bluetooth is switched off. Turn it on, then come back.
This tablet is not on WiFi. Join the café network first.
A slip should come out of the printer.
Did a slip come out of the printer at your counter?
Check the paper roll is the right way round — thermal paper only prints on one side, so a reversed roll feeds through and comes out blank. Then check the printer is not out of paper, and try again.
Tickets for %1$s print here automatically. You can turn the screen off.
